name: liber-usualis
description: A project dedicated to making the Mass, Hours, and Rites of various editions of the Roman Rite easily accessible and beautifully formatted with or without their chants.

scripts.build: esbuild frontend/pray.js --bundle --minify --sourcemap --outdir=web/resources/dist --format=iife --global-name=Pray && esbuild frontend/css/pray.css --bundle --minify --sourcemap --outfile=web/resources/dist/pray.css && esbuild render.js --bundle --minify --outfile=render-build.js --platform=node
